pages.title: 品质与交付
pages.summary: 围绕电机与水泵规格组织制造、装配与检验，从产品要求到包装发运，让采购与交付信息清楚一致。
pages.imageAlt: 电机与水泵装配场景示意

sections.title: 生产与品质管理
sections.intro: 产品规格是制造与检验的共同依据。采购前明确使用条件，有助于确认适用型号与质量要求。

items.title: 产品规格确认
items.description: 确认电机或水泵系列、供电条件、安装尺寸与使用工况；替换现有设备时，可提供铭牌照片或原型号资料。

items.title: 生产与装配
items.description: 按产品规格组织制造、装配和过程管理，围绕电机与水泵的配套要求开展生产协同。

items.title: 检验要求沟通
items.description: 结合型号与使用要求确认检测项目。如采购需要检验资料、验收条件或其他质量文件，请在订单确认前提出。

sections.title: 包装与交付确认
sections.intro: 把数量、时间、包装与收货要求提前说明，方便核对供货安排和交付条件。

items.title: 数量与交期
items.description: 提交所需型号、采购数量和期望到货时间，由客服团队结合产品与订单情况确认供货安排。

items.title: 包装与运输
items.description: 说明收货地址、运输安排、包装及装卸要求。具体包装方式、运费与交付条款在采购确认时沟通。

items.title: 随货与收货核对
items.description: 提前确认所需产品资料和随货文件。收货时核对型号、数量与外包装；如有问题，请保留采购信息与现场照片，联系客户服务。

pages.requirementsIntro: 把以下信息写入采购需求，有助于团队准确核对产品、价格和交付条件。

requirements.label: 型号规格
requirements.value: 产品系列、型号、供电条件、安装尺寸和使用工况

requirements.label: 数量与时间
requirements.value: 采购数量、是否分批，以及期望到货日期

requirements.label: 收货与运输
requirements.value: 收货地址、联系人、运输及装卸要求

requirements.label: 包装与资料
requirements.value: 包装要求、所需产品资料和随货文件

steps.title: 提交需求
steps.description: 选择产品，填写数量、规格与收货要求。

steps.title: 核对条件
steps.description: 确认适用型号、商务条款和交付安排。

steps.title: 订单与供货
steps.description: 按确认后的订单要求协同生产和发运。

steps.title: 收货与反馈
steps.description: 核对产品与资料，沟通后续配套及服务需求。

faq.question: 能否直接确定价格和交期？
faq.answer: 请提交产品型号、规格、数量、收货地址及期望日期。客服团队核对需求后确认价格与交期。

faq.question: 采购需要指定检测项目怎么办？
faq.answer: 请说明验收要求或提供项目文件，由团队结合型号确认检测范围及所需资料。

faq.question: 是否可以提出特殊包装和随货资料要求？
faq.answer: 可以在采购需求中写明包装、运输和资料要求，具体方案及商务条件由客服团队确认。

pages.contactIntro: 选择产品并填写数量、规格和期望交期；对检测或交付条件有疑问，可直接咨询客服。

pages.title: 技术与服务
pages.summary: 面向设备配套、工程采购与维修备件，提供电机与水泵选型、定制配套沟通和售后支持。
pages.imageAlt: 水泵与管路配套场景示意

sections.title: 产品选型与配套
sections.intro: 从使用条件出发确认产品。电机与水泵的选型资料各有侧重，完整信息有助于进一步核对。

items.title: 电机选型
items.description: 请提供功率需求、电压、频率、配套设备、安装方式与运行环境。替换现有电机时，铭牌照片和安装尺寸可帮助核对。

items.title: 水泵选型
items.description: 请提供输送介质、流量、扬程、安装位置、管路条件和运行方式。已有设备可附原型号或现场照片。

items.title: 接口与设备配套
items.description: 提交连接尺寸、安装空间、配套设备资料或项目图纸，结合实际工况确认适配要求。

sections.title: 定制、售后与备件
sections.intro: 围绕具体产品与项目沟通服务范围，明确技术要求和后续处理方式。

items.title: 定制需求确认
items.description: 将所需电气规格、接口尺寸、外观或包装要求提交客服。具体可调整范围、费用和交期结合产品型号确认。

items.title: 安装与使用咨询
items.description: 咨询时请说明产品型号、安装条件和运行环境。如需安装资料或使用说明，可在采购前或服务沟通时提出。

items.title: 问题反馈与备件
items.description: 提供铭牌照片、采购信息、运行情况和问题表现；备件需求请说明部件名称、原型号或尺寸，便于核对后续处理。

pages.requirementsIntro: 可把文字需求填入采购单，也可向客服说明现有型号、使用条件和项目目标。

requirements.label: 电机需求
requirements.value: 功率、电压、频率、配套设备、安装方式、使用环境

requirements.label: 水泵需求
requirements.value: 介质、流量、扬程、安装位置、管路和运行方式

requirements.label: 定制配套
requirements.value: 图纸、接口尺寸、规格调整和数量要求

requirements.label: 售后备件
requirements.value: 型号铭牌、采购信息、问题描述、现场或部件照片

steps.title: 描述工况
steps.description: 说明使用场景、产品要求或现有设备问题。

steps.title: 提交资料
steps.description: 提供型号、参数、图纸或相关照片。

steps.title: 核对方案
steps.description: 沟通选型、配套范围与具体服务条件。

steps.title: 采购或服务
steps.description: 确认需求后进入采购或后续服务处理。

faq.question: 暂时不知道型号，可以先咨询吗？
faq.answer: 可以。请先说明用途、供电与安装条件；水泵还需流量、扬程和介质等信息，客服可据此进一步了解需求。

faq.question: 定制需要提供哪些信息？
faq.answer: 请提供现有型号、所需调整、图纸或尺寸，以及数量和时间要求。实际适配范围和商务条件需结合产品确认。

faq.question: 设备出现问题时如何反馈？
faq.answer: 请说明型号、使用条件和问题表现，并准备铭牌及现场照片。若涉及安全风险，请按设备使用说明处理，再联系客户服务。

pages.title: Quality & delivery
pages.summary: Manufacturing, assembly and inspection for motor and pump specifications, with clear coordination of product requirements, packing and shipment.
pages.imageAlt: Illustration of motor and pump assembly

sections.title: Production & quality
sections.intro: Product specifications guide manufacturing and inspection. Share operating conditions before purchasing to confirm the model and quality requirements.

items.title: Confirm specifications
items.description: Provide the product series, power supply, mounting dimensions and operating conditions. A nameplate photo or original model helps with replacement purchases.

items.title: Production and assembly
items.description: Manufacturing, assembly and process coordination follow the product specifications and equipment requirements.

items.title: Discuss inspection requirements
items.description: Confirm inspection requirements for the model and application. Specify acceptance criteria and any inspection documents before order confirmation.

sections.title: Packing & delivery
sections.intro: Discuss quantity, timing, packing and destination in advance so supply and delivery conditions can be confirmed.

items.title: Quantity and lead time
items.description: Submit the model, order quantity and target arrival date. Customer service confirms supply arrangements for the product and order.

items.title: Packing and transport
items.description: Provide the delivery address, transport arrangements and packing or handling requirements. Packing methods, freight and delivery terms are discussed before purchase confirmation.

items.title: Documents and receipt
items.description: Confirm required product information and shipment documents in advance. Check model, quantity and packaging on arrival; keep order information and photos available when reporting an issue.

requirements.label: Destination
requirements.value: Delivery address, contact, transport and handling requirements

requirements.label: Packing & files

steps.description: Select products and provide quantity, specifications and delivery needs.

steps.title: Confirm terms
steps.description: Review the model, commercial terms and delivery arrangements.

steps.title: Order and supply
steps.description: Coordinate supply and shipment against confirmed order requirements.

steps.title: Receipt and feedback
steps.description: Check products and documents, then discuss any further support.

faq.question: Can price and lead time be confirmed immediately?
faq.answer: Send the model, specifications, quantity, destination and target date. Customer service reviews the request before confirming price and lead time.

faq.question: What if a project needs specific inspections?
faq.answer: Share acceptance criteria or project documents so the team can confirm inspection scope and required documentation for the model.

faq.question: Can I request packing or shipment documents?
faq.answer: Include packing, transport and document requirements in your purchase request. The team confirms arrangements and commercial terms.

pages.title: Technical support
pages.summary: Motor and pump selection, customization coordination and after-sales support for equipment, project procurement and service parts.
pages.imageAlt: Illustration of a pump and piping application

sections.title: Selection & equipment
sections.intro: Selection starts with operating conditions. Motors and pumps require different information to review the application.

items.title: Motor selection
items.description: Provide power requirements, voltage, frequency, driven equipment, mounting method and operating environment. Include a nameplate photo and dimensions for replacement motors.

items.title: Pump selection
items.description: Provide the fluid, flow, head, installation position, piping conditions and operating requirements. Include the existing model or site photos where available.

items.title: Connections and mounting
items.description: Share connection dimensions, installation space, equipment information or drawings to confirm compatibility requirements.

sections.title: Customization & support
sections.intro: Discuss the specific product and project to define technical requirements and the scope of service.

items.title: Customization requirements
items.description: Send requested electrical specifications, connection dimensions, appearance or packing requirements. Available adjustments, cost and lead time are confirmed for the model.

items.title: Installation and operation
items.description: Include the model, installation conditions and operating environment. Request installation or operating documents before purchase or during service discussions.

items.title: Issue reporting and parts
items.description: Share the nameplate, order information, operating conditions and symptoms. For parts, provide the component name, original model or dimensions for review.

pages.requirementsIntro: Describe your model, operating conditions and project needs in a purchase request or customer service conversation.

requirements.label: Motor
requirements.value: Power, voltage, frequency, driven equipment, mounting and environment

requirements.label: Pump
requirements.value: Fluid, flow, head, position, piping and operating requirements

requirements.label: Customization
requirements.value: Drawings, connection dimensions, adjustments and quantities

requirements.label: After-sales
requirements.value: Nameplate, order information, symptoms and site or component photos

steps.title: Describe the use
steps.description: Explain the application, product requirements or equipment issue.

steps.title: Share information
steps.description: Provide the model, parameters, drawings or relevant photos.

steps.title: Review the scope
steps.description: Discuss selection, compatibility and service arrangements.

steps.title: Purchase or support
steps.description: Proceed with procurement or support after confirming requirements.

faq.question: Can I ask before I know the model?
faq.answer: Yes. Describe the application, power supply and installation conditions. For pumps, provide flow, head and fluid details so customer service can understand your needs.

faq.question: What is needed for customization?
faq.answer: Share the existing model, required adjustments, drawings or dimensions, quantity and target date. Compatibility and commercial terms are confirmed for the product.

faq.question: How should I report an equipment issue?
faq.answer: Describe the model, operating conditions and symptoms, and prepare nameplate and site photos. Follow the equipment instructions if a safety issue is involved, then contact customer service.
